class_imbalance._comment: tau is SEARCHED in [0.05, 0.8]. tau=1.0, the parameter-free default, over-corrects at this imbalance: dev fold 2 single-task `feature` scored 0.009 at tau=1.0 against 0.484 at tau=0.25.
class_imbalance._selected_by: grouped Optuna search over the dev folds

_provenance.selection: single Optuna search over all of train, dev folds as inner CV
_provenance.why: per-outer-fold hyperparameters would be selected on fold difficulty; fold 4 scored 0.453 against 0.154-0.238 because it had 98.8 % in-vocabulary coverage and a 75.3 % majority class
_provenance.reader_learning_rate: 1e-04, chosen by the dev-fold sweep in results/seqenc_lrsweep_v9/ before this arm ran; the MLP keeps its searched rate
_provenance.epoch_budget: 625 epochs at 8 steps each = about 5000 reader updates, patience equal to the budget
_provenance.card_length: hidden_dims[0] = 192, read off the replaced layer rather than configured

_comment: S4 control: identical in every respect to results/seqenc_test_v9 except that each unitig's bases were permuted within that unitig under seed 42 before encoding. Base composition, length, the feature matrix and the labels are untouched, so the only thing removed is sequence ORDER. This arm exists to stop a capacity effect being reported as a sequence effect. Held-out untouched.
